Although Södermalm usually is considered an island, water to both its north and south does not flow freely but passes through locks.

The area around Slussen (Götgatan, Götstreet) have many cool bars, café and good shopping.

description: Cosy 44 m² apartment located in Gamla stan, the Old town.
neighborhood_overview:
The apartment is perfectly located in Gamla stan, geographically in the middle of Stockholm, with the Central station just across the bridge northward, and trendy Södermalm across the bridge southward.

Gamla stan is the oldest part of Stockholm, dating back to the 13th century. Here you'll find many cosy cafés, restaurants and boutiques. There are two small supermarkets nearby where you can get groceries. A pharmacy is also located close by.

From Skeppsbron, five minutes from the apartment, you can take a boat or ferry out to the archipelago, or just to the opposite island Djurgården. There you'll find Skansen, a park with nordic animals as well as old farms and houses transported from all over Sweden and reconstructed in the park. The Tivoli Gröna Lund, Aquarium, Vasa Museum and Junibacken are on the same island.

This part of Stockholm is called lower Norrmalm. It is the most central area in Stockholm, possible to live undisturbed and still just a stone’s throw from restaurants, bars, coffee shops, theatres and shopping. It is also close to several parks and museums, such as the Strindberg Museum in the "Blue Tower". It's walking distance to the Old Town, the medieval part of Stockholm with the Royal Castle and a lot of shopping.
200 meters away, at Norra Bantorget, there is a huge outdoor terrace in summer with restaurants and bars. A nice place for evening hangouts.


And don't miss the chance to experience the archipelago. There are fantastic opportunities to make a day trip around the beautiful water landscape of Stockholm by boat.

description: Glory2 is a spacious 2 bedroom apartment of 122 sqm, with a fully equipped kitchen and large living room. neighborhood_overview: Our apartments are located in the Old Town, which is one of Stockholm's most appreciated sites among tourists. Here you can wander the narrow cobble stone streets and alleys and enjoy the buildings dating back to the 16th and 17th century; you can visit the Royal Palace and Nobel museum as well as the Grand Square (The most photographed place in Stockholm); and as if that weren't enough, the Old Town is filled with really good restaurants, cafés and shops, everything within a very short walk from our building. The boats to the Island of Djurgården and the archipelago departs from Slussen, a 2 minute walk from our building and in December you can visit the famous Christmas market at the Grand square. Located right in between the modern city center and trendy Södermalm, the Old Town is the perfect starting point for exploring both old and new Stockholm. Since traffic is more or less prohibited in the Old Town it is usually a rather quiet neighborhood with mainly pedestrian street noise.

Sankt Eriksgatan is centrally located on Kungsholmen.
Only 5 minutes walk from / to the airport bus stop at Sankt Eriksplan or at Fridhemsplan.
The area is full of bustling city life with excellent communications.
Along the Karlberg Canal you get a lovely walk towards the City and Central Station in about 10-15 minutes.

From City Hall it is only a few minutes walk to Central Station and the City Terminal, the Old Town and other central parts of the capital.

neighborhood_overview:
Kungsholmen is primarily a residential island, where you'll have a great opportunity to mix with the locals. Lots of lively restaurants, bars, and cafés are found here, especially along Hantverkargatan and Fleminggatan. Kungsholmen is home to the most prominent building of the Stockholm skyline, the City Hall. If you get the chance, don’t miss climbing the tower to be amazed by the incredible view.

The walk along the tree-lined quay on Norrmälarstrand offers unparalleled views of Södermalm and boats sailing on the lake. If you continue past the City Hall you can actually stroll around the whole island along the water. It's a popular track for locals and is often either finished or started with a brunch in one of the many cafés in the area.

During summer, there are a couple of nice places to go for a swim on the island, for instance in the big green area of Rålambshovsparken. For a truly exotic experience, we recommend a swim from the rocks of Fredhällsbadet.

Hello, my name is Susanna Norén, I live in a villa on Stora Essingen in Stockholm with my husband Jonas, our two children, grandmother Eva and our dog Vilma. Therefore I get to enjoy both the tranquility of the countryside but also enjoy the convenience of living central. Here I get the best of both worlds.

What I like the most about Stora Essingen is how it’s surrounded by water and the aforementioned tranquility that the island posseses. I like to exploit how close the water is and take my morning dips in the local bathing spot: Oxhålet, which is just a ten-minute walk away from my house!

In my sparetime I like to ride my bicycle and do yoga, but I also very much enjoy taking our dog for walks. The dog and I both like hiking, so it’s not uncommon for us to do so up to several times a year. Other things I like is Sushi, romantic comedies and to read books (preferably a nice detective story or a biografy).

Everyone in my family loves to travel and we all have our different ideas of what makes an ideal vacation, when I travel alone I prefer smaller, more personal living spaces than the luxurious (and expensive) hotels one might come across.

My life’s motto is: ”treat others the way you want to be treated.”

In addition to the shopping, there are also many shopping malls and grocery stores around Södermalm. Dear Airbnb guest,

Stockholm Hostel is a clean, modern comfortable airbnb hostel with 33 rooms with simple standard in the west centre of Stockholm, located at the district Kungsholmen.
From here you can reach most city landmarks by foot within 15-35 minutes and the closest Metro and bus is only a walking distance of 3 minutes away which will take you anywhere in Stockholm. The airport bus-stop is also around the corner at Fridhemsplan station.

In the summer, bring your swimming gear. The canal of where you can rent SUP (StandUpPaddle Boards) or just have a quick dip or swim is only down the street about 1500 meters. 

Please note that this is a semi-automatic facility with smart and simple self check-in. Our staff is always available here in the AirBnb messages, you can reach us for any questions regarding your stay or recommendations of everything Stockholm has to offer or if you simply just wanna say hi :-)

Stockholm Hostel is runned by us, Marius and Nicole with many years of experience from the hotel industry. Warmest Regards, 
Marius & Nicole

Gamla Stan, the Old Town, is one of the largest and best preserved medieval city centers in Europe, and one of the foremost attractions in Stockholm. This is where Stockholm was founded in 1252.

All of Gamla Stan and the adjacent island of Riddarholmen are like a living pedestrian-friendly museum full of sights, attractions, restaurants, cafés, bars, and places to shop. Gamla Stan is also popular with aficionados of handicrafts, curious, and souvenirs.

The narrow winding cobblestone streets, with their buildings in so many different shades of gold, give Gamla Stan its unique character. Even now cellar vaults and frescoes from the Middle Ages can be found behind the visible facades, and on snowy winter days, the district feels like something from a storybook.

There are several beautiful churches and museums in Gamla Stan, including Sweden’s national cathedral Stockholm Cathedral and the Nobel Museum.

neighborhood_overview:
Sköndal (Niceville) is a district in the Farsta borough of southern Stockholm. It neighbours Gubbängen to the northwest, Hökarängen to the west, Farsta to the southwest and Larsboda to the south. To the east and partially north it neighbours the Skarpnäck borough, in particular the districts of Skarpnäcks Gård and Orhem.

The area was largely developed in the 1950s and 1960, with the building of a number of apartment blocks. In 1969 the shopping centre Sköndals Centrum was built, consisting of small number of shops around an open square. The local library is found here, along with a small supermarket, a newsagents and a bar.

Located by the lake 900 meters away you also find an outdoor gym.

Sköndal is well served by Stockholm's public transport system, with buses running from Sköndal to Gullmarsplan and Skarpnäck.

name: “Villa” with private garden - 9 min from downtown
description: This is a unique apartment built in an old villa, just minutes from lake Mälaren with amazing bathing opportunities and kayak rentals, as well as a metro stop around the corner that takes you downtown in under 10 minutes. No wonder this area is among the most popular in all of Stockholm! You’ll have your own, spacious garden with a lush pergola, covered with vines and tomato plants. You don’t get this type of place any more central than this!
neighborhood_overview:
A nice and quiet villa suburb with many impressive houses.

Groceries: A fairly large grocery store is right by the metro stop, 2 minutes from the apartment.

Recycling: If you walk past the grocery store entrance you’ll find the recycling station.

Bathing: The lake Mälaren is right down the street from the apartment. I recommend Piren or Fridhemabryggan (if you want to jump or dive). Look it up on maps.

Lunch/coffee: A nice walk along the water you’ll find the historical restaurant Lyran located on the top of a hill. You’ll see it from the walkway (look it up on maps).

Dinner: The area doesn’t have many restaurants, but one good place for burgers and pizza is Brödernas which is just a few minutes walk away.

Liljeholmskajen is a popular up-and-coming location in Stockholm, close to Södermalm, and with many newly built condominiums, restaurants and outdoor swimming areas.

The area of Liljeholmskajen was formerly an industrial and harbor area called Årstadalshamnen. Here, construction company JM owns roughly 230,000 square meters of storage space distributed over five separate underground premises that were previously used by state-owned Vin & Sprit for the storage of wine and spirits. The tunnels are approximately 150 meters long, around 20 meters wide and upwards of 20 meters high.

After the year 2000, the industries began to move from the area to make way for condominium production within the Liljeholmskajen project. Liljeholmskajen is an urban development project under JM's auspices, which includes the production and sale of lakeside homes in Årstadal and Årstaberg.

neighborhood_overview:
Midsommarkransen is a charming and cosy neighborhood in southern Stockholm, only two metro stations from Södermalm. Here you can enjoy a quiet and green atmosphere, while being close to the pulse of the city and sights. The area has a rich history stretching from the 18th century tavern to 20th century brick mills and Alfred Nobel's ancient factories.

Today you will find many nice cafes, restaurants, shops and galleries in the yellow houses with red roofs. You can also step out from the gate straight into Svandammsparken or walk across the farm to Tellus cinema. The Midsummer wreath is a perfect place to stay if you'd like to experience Stockholm from a local's perspective.

name: Superior Queen
description: Nestled in Vasastan, Clas på hörnet Hotel revitalizes an 18th-century tavern into a sophisticated boutique, preserving original details and craftsmanship. Our 24 rooms, individually furnished, provide a home-away-from-home. The modern design with vintage accents defines seven distinctive room categories. Located on Surbrunnsgatan and Birger Jarlsgatan, Clas på hörnet, dating back to 1731, stands as Stockholm's iconic and oldest tavern, upholding the timeless name 'Clas på hörnet'.
neighborhood_overview:
Vasastan is an attractive and lively neighbourhood just a few blocks away from Odenplan and City Centre. The area offers visitors a perfect blend of calmness and livelines. Its proximity to green parks enables Clas på Hörnet to provide you with the best of both worlds! A tranquil environment in the heart of the buzzing city.

The neighbourhood is home to many nice restaurants such as Tako and Vassa Eggen on Birger Jarlsgatan. L’Avventura on Sveavägen, and Arirang as well as Urban Deli are popular eating spots too. Babette is perfect for nice pizza and bar snacks. Brasserie Balzac, Le Nom and Buco Nero are all on Jarlaplan.

Nearby parks like Humlegården, Vasaparken and Observatorielunden are reachable within short walking distance. You can reach Hagaparken and Lill-Jan's forest on foot, where you can enjoy lovely walking/jogging paths.

Old Town, or Gamla Stan, is a historic neighborhood located in the heart of Stockholm, Sweden. It is one of the best-preserved medieval city centers in Europe and is an absolute must-visit for anyone exploring the city.

Walking through the narrow, cobblestone streets of Old Town feels like stepping back in time. The area is filled with beautifully preserved buildings dating back to the 13th century, with colorful facades and charming architecture. The Royal Palace, Stockholm Cathedral, and Stortorget, the oldest square in the city, are some of the main attractions in the area.

Aside from its historical significance, Old Town is also a hub for culture, shopping, and dining. You'll find a plethora of souvenir shops, boutiques, and art galleries showcasing both traditional and contemporary Swedish craftsmanship. host_about:
Dear Airbnb guest,

Stockholm Hostel is a clean, modern comfortable airbnb hostel with 33 rooms with simple standard in the west centre of Stockholm, located at the district Kungsholmen.
From here you can reach most city landmarks by foot within 15-35 minutes and the closest Metro and bus is only a walking distance of 3 minutes away which will take you anywhere in Stockholm. The airport bus-stop is also around the corner at Fridhemsplan station.

Here we have fast wi-fi and all our bedrooms are private with ensuite toilet & shower. 
Please note most rooms are without windows,  so make sure you booked the right room. 
As our guest you have free access to a big kitchen where you can cook your own meals together with other guests. 

Kitchen availabilities:
Stove - Yes (2)
Dishwasher - Yes (2)
Cutlery, plates, glasses - Yes
Fridge - Yes 
Freezer - Yes
Microwave - Yes
Oven - No

Supermarkets like Lidl, Willys, ICA is just around the corner as well as restaurants and bars. 
The Galleria Västermalmsgallerian is in the next building with wide variety of stores such as H&M and Joe & the Juice.

In the summer, bring your swimming gear. The canal of where you can rent SUP (StandUpPaddle Boards) or just have a quick dip or swim is only down the street about 1500 meters. 

Please note that this is a semi-automatic facility with smart and simple self check-in. Our staff is always available here in the AirBnb messages, you can reach us for any questions regarding your stay or recommendations of everything Stockholm has to offer or if you simply just wanna say hi :-)

Stockholm Hostel is runned by us, Marius and Nicole with many years of experience from the hotel industry. We love what we are doing and are always trying to help our guests in the best possible way; with anything you might need to make your trip as great as possible or simply to get a good night's sleep. 

Warmest Regards, 
Marius & Nicole
Managers of Stockholm Hostel

Dear Airbnb guest,

Stockholm Hostel is a clean, modern comfortable airbnb hostel with 33 rooms with simple standard in the west centre of Stockholm, located at the district Kungsholmen.
From here you can reach most city landmarks by foot within 15-35 minutes and the closest Metro and bus is only a walking distance of 3 minutes away which will take you anywhere in Stockholm. The airport bus-stop is also around the corner at Fridhemsplan station.

Here we have fast wi-fi and all our bedrooms are private with ensuite toilet & shower. 
Please note most rooms are without windows,  so make sure you booked the right room. 
As our guest you have free access to a big kitchen where you can cook your own meals together with other guests.

Marius & Nicole

neighborhood_overview:
Kungsholmen is primarily a residential island. Lots of lively restaurants, bars, and cafés are found here, especially along Hantverkargatan and Fleminggatan. Kungsholmen is home to the most prominent building of the Stockholm skyline, the City Hall.

The walk along the tree-lined quay on Norrmälarstrand offers unparalleled views of Södermalm and boats sailing on the lake. If you continue past the City Hall you can actually stroll around the whole island along the water. It's a popular track for locals and is often either finished or started with a brunch in one of the many cafés in the area.

During summer, there are a couple of nice places to go for a swim on the island, for instance in the big green area of Rålambshovsparken. For a truly Stockholm experience, we recommend a swim from the rocks of Fredhällsbadet.
